svg.title: RegMind — five-agent regulatory compliance pipeline
svg.desc: A top-down flowchart showing five autonomous agents: RegWatcher ingests regulatory sources, MapMaker decomposes them into MAPs, RouteMaster assigns to departments, AuditEye validates completion, and RegBoard provides executive insight.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the RegWatcher ingestion agent in RegMind')
sendPrompt('How does MapMaker create Measurable Action Points?')
sendPrompt('How does RouteMaster assign MAPs to departments?')
sendPrompt('How does AuditEye validate MAP completion?')
sendPrompt('What does the RegBoard executive dashboard show?')
